findings.summary: Cross-modal consistency check failed for K7_C07 because it has only one member; no metrics were produced for any set.

Strong technical conflict detected: ct_study_year shows large effect size (max pairwise Cliff's delta 0.865) and significant global association (q=0.0045). Set-level analysis reveals K7_C01 has lower study year (Cliff's delta -0.49, q=0.231) and K7_C06 has higher study year (Cliff's delta 0.484, q=0.126), indicating potential temporal confounding.

Partition does not echo known labels: AMI with stage is 0.037 and with grade is 0.006, both far below near-identity thresholds (0.8). Optimal mapping accuracy is 0.304 for stage and 0.255 for grade, indicating no strong redundancy with clinical labels.
